subject.title: feat(agents): add scoped command prompt projection

question: Should the default agent prompt expose only core routed CLI operations, or also opt-in plugin and paired-node commands through the proposed public metadata contract?
rationale: That choice determines the permanent plugin API, runtime owner, operator-scope plumbing, and model-visible command policy; the current patch claims the broader behavior without completing its production integration.

options.title: Core routes first
options.body: Narrow this slice to core routed operations and defer plugin and node prompt exposure until their runtime contract is separately approved.

options.title: Approve broad projection
options.body: Retain plugin and node support, but thread runtime-prepared inventories and operator scope through the prompt boundary and prove every case before merge.

options.title: Defer prompt consumption
options.body: Pause this dependent slice until the command inventory foundation is merged and its public API is stable.

recommendation.title: Core routes first
recommendation.body: Narrow this slice to core routed operations and defer plugin and node prompt exposure until their runtime contract is separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent source history gives the strongest ownership signal for both the agent prompt composition and adjacent plugin CLI contract.
